styles.title: Nightglass Courier
styles.rendering: Clean action manhwa. Precise tapered contour and crisp clean action-manhwa shapes; refined adult faces with limited soft modeling inside clearly bounded shadow masses, economical highlights and selective cyan edge light. Indigo concrete and black glass; pearl workwear; cyan only on energized surfaces, one small scarlet safety accent. Architecture uses a slab, a suspended span and one cable; avoid signage forests and floating interface graphics.
styles.world_rule: Bridge cables collect atmospheric charge. Homes receive equal evening allotments; glass geckos graze spilled charge, so neglected insulation turns a public walkway into feeding ground.

styles.title: Sunbreak Lancer
styles.rendering: Warm outlined painting (observed reference; old intent label was kinetic color manga). Warm dark expressive contours over broad painted ochre light and cool blue shadows; confident faces with restrained surface texture. Chalk plaster, red canvas, green bamboo and dull brass; large sail triangles, never a web of little kites. Bright sunny space, at most one dominant sail per location; wind expressed through a few large cloth curves.
styles.world_rule: Roof sails pull the neighborhood's flour mills and shade its communal ovens. Wind belongs to the block; stealing airflow leaves a neighboring roof hungry and overheated.

styles.title: Iron Orchard
styles.rendering: Textured painting (observed reference; old intent label was retro cel animation). Opaque textured paint, firm drawn edges where needed, broad weathered color planes and expressive dimensional adult faces. Faded olive canvas, rust steel, blue enamel and cream orchard bark; wear concentrated at contacts, not all-over decorative grime. One rail, one tree mass and one useful machine per scene; no tangle of gears or tiny rivets.
styles.world_rule: The orchard's iron-rich roots grow around abandoned rails. Furnace boars digest rotten fruit and rust into fertile slag; the co-op must leave both food sources for them rather than sell every rail.

styles.title: Red Current

styles.title: Cathedral Engine

styles.title: Black Petal

entries.title: Sera Venn — Live-line inspector and veteran bridge rescuer
entries.brief: One new adult woman, Sera Venn, age 64. Short, lean, slight stoop, wiry hands and a narrow triangular silhouette. Face: Deep brown skin, long hooked nose, hooded eyes, prominent cheekbones and fine smile lines; close silver crop with a squared hairline. Costume: Pearl straight knee coat with a single large diagonal black shoulder panel, split back for climbing, charcoal narrow trousers and flat insulated boots; one scarlet cuff tab, no jewelry. Pose and expression: Low balanced step onto a plain ledge, long coat making one sharp triangular shape behind her; one gloved hand aims the insulated clamp forward to catch a live cable, other arm extends for balance. Fierce amused eyes; elderly action-lead presence, whole body and tool visible. Exactly one held object: Insulated cable clamp; A black C-shaped jaw with a single long pearl rubber handle and one scarlet lock button. It temporarily isolates a damaged charged cable. No second person or extra inventory. Action design rationale, not an additional depicted scene: The insulated clamp catches and pins a whipping charged cable while her body stays outside its sweep.
entries.caption: 64; Live-line inspector and veteran bridge rescuer. Dry, exacting, secretly indulgent toward mistakes honestly admitted. Wants to keep her block's lights running without hiding the utility's neglected repairs.

entries.title: Daska Vale — Freight brake captain
entries.brief: One new adult woman, Daska Vale, age 40. Very tall, thick-waisted and heavily muscled with broad thighs, a deep chest and large working hands. Face: Square mature face, broad nose, small sharp eyes and a heavy brow; short straight dark hair in a severe bowl crop, one missing front tooth visible in her grin. Costume: Black sleeveless square-neck work suit with white shoulder pads integrated into cloth, calf-length wide legs and flat red brake soles; no wraps or giant boxing gloves. Pose and expression: Wide low stance with one red brake wedge carried in the lowered right hand, other hand relaxed; fierce approving grin. Exactly one held object: Brake wedge; One thick red triangular rubber wedge with a single black recessed handgrip on its rear face. It seats under a freight wheel to arrest an uncontrolled cart. No second person or extra inventory.
entries.caption: 40; Freight brake captain. Demanding, funny, intolerant of showboating. Wants to keep freight certification open to workers who cannot afford guild tuition.

entries.title: Kio Noll — Apprentice route judge and counterstep fighter
entries.brief: One new adult man, Kio Noll, age 22. Short and slight, narrow shoulders, thin wrists and notably long shins; adult proportions, not a child. Face: Fine oval adult face, prominent ears, straight narrow nose, wide serious eyes and uneven thick eyebrows; soft black curls cropped above the ears. Costume: White short-sleeve high-collar referee tunic, loose black knee-length shorts over white leggings, black low shoes and one plain red chest stripe. Pose and expression: Elastic wide sidestep on a plain sloped slab, one knee bent and the other leg long; single route paddle raised across his outside shoulder ready to parry, free hand extended for balance. Sudden sharp competitive smile, adult wiry anatomy. Exactly one held object: Route judge's paddle; One thick rigid white rectangular blade with a black center reinforcement bar on a short red handle; no printed marks. It gives an unmistakable stop signal at the blind turn. No second person or extra inventory. Action design rationale, not an additional depicted scene: The rigid route paddle signals a stop, then serves as a short parrying blade; his advantage is foot placement and redirection, not heavy armor.
entries.caption: 22; Apprentice route judge and counterstep fighter. Earnest, analytical and unexpectedly daring when someone is hurt. Wants to make stop-distance rulings fair instead of protecting famous crews.

entries.title: Halden Rue — Public heat steward
entries.brief: One new adult man, Halden Rue, age 68. Broad, thick and gently stooped with a heavy stomach, strong forearms and short bowed legs. Face: Wide wrinkled face, bulbous nose, heavy drooping eyelids and a short square white beard; full swept-back white hair, no bald head or long sculpted moustache. Costume: Plain dark ankle-length felt coat with a broad parchment-colored square collar, stout boots and a single brass front clasp; no patterned fabric. Pose and expression: One hand holding a short bell-damping mallet across his thigh, other spread in a patient explanation; gentle skeptical eyes. entries.caption: 68; Public heat steward. Kind, stubborn and very difficult to rush. Wants to keep the lowest district's baths warm without exhausting the pump animals.

entries.title: Vessa Orr — Bell rigger and tactical resonator tracker

Face: Narrow wedge face, sharply upturned nose, small bright eyes and a long dimple in one cheek; straight dark hair shaved at the nape with a thick blunt fringe. Costume: Parchment-toned fitted work tunic beneath a plain dark cropped leather shoulder bib, broad dark culottes and simple lace boots; no armor or corset lacing. Pose and expression: Low braced lunge with one broad trouser leg forward, short shoulder bib creating a compact armored-looking silhouette without armor; long pipe key held across the body from a single clear grip, jaw angled to catch a support pin. Intense delighted focus, whole figure visible. Exactly one held object: Pipe key; One long flat bronze bar with a large square open jaw and a simple rounded grip end. It turns the bath pump's square valve stem; the jaw shape visibly matches the job. No second person or extra inventory. Action design rationale, not an additional depicted scene: The square key jaw catches a bell support pin as a pivot, letting her swing or brace clear of a charging hound without adding a weapon.
entries.caption: 33; Bell rigger and tactical resonator tracker. Restless, ingenious, proud of invisible reliable work. Wants to replace a dangerous cracked bell before the council buys another ceremonial one.

entries.title: Jun Tessel — Public route surveyor and frontier pathfinder
entries.brief: One new adult woman, Jun Tessel, age 57. Very tall and angular, long neck, narrow flat chest and large knuckled hands; slight forward lean. Face: Golden-brown skin, long horse-shaped face, prominent curved nose, small dark eyes and a deeply notched chin; smooth silver hair in a short wedge cut, no spectacles. Costume: Mint sleeveless knee coat over a cream stand-collar shirt, terracotta straight trousers and simple black ankle boots; one broad functional coat pocket. Pose and expression: Long confident stride across one small clearly supported step gap, mint coat framing a tall narrow angular silhouette; one hand extends the folded level frame as a probe, the free arm balances. Inquisitive daring smile, entire figure and both supported feet visible. Exactly one held object: Folding level frame; One cream triangular frame with a single dark plumb cord hanging inside; the cord terminates in a small attached terracotta weight. entries.caption: 57; Public route surveyor and frontier pathfinder. Curious, tactless and quietly optimistic. Wants to keep a shifting neighborhood connected instead of letting officials abandon its oldest residents.

entries.title: Fen Barlow — Forecast cook
entries.brief: One new adult man, Fen Barlow, age 45. Broad, very soft and heavy with a large belly, thick upper arms and surprisingly small feet; round teardrop silhouette. Face: Dark brown skin, broad oval face, a large rounded nose, full lower lip and sleepy smiling eyes; close black hair with a small white forelock, clean-shaven. Costume: Orange short-sleeve cook's tunic with a large turquoise square chest pocket, dark green straight trousers and pale slip-on work shoes; no singlet or gauntlets. Pose and expression: Holding one broad turquoise wind ladle low and outward, free hand on belly; a delighted knowing smile. Exactly one held object: Wind ladle; One broad turquoise half-bowl with a long orange handle and a single large oval vent through the bowl. It samples wind direction and catches the first rain to tell the cook when to cover the ovens. No second person or extra inventory.

entries.brief: One new adult woman, Ysra Pike, age 34. Exceptionally tall and wiry, long hooked shoulders, very long hands and thin bowed legs; unmistakably adult and athletic. Face: Pale freckled skin, long angular face, sharp triangular nose, enormous slanted eyebrows and a narrow chin; bright orange hair in a short spiky crop, not pink locs. Costume: Turquoise long-sleeve cropped utility jacket closed at the neck, cream high-waisted wide trousers and green flat boots; one orange seat patch, no loose sash. Pose and expression: Exaggerated but grounded long-legged brace against a strong imaginary gust; one hand carries the single folded lee screen diagonally like a compact shield, the other points upward. Jacket and trouser shapes form a vivid zigzag; huge fearless grin. Exactly one held object: Folded lee screen; One compact orange canvas rectangle folded onto a turquoise hinged U-frame, with its single carry handle visible. It opens into a quiet windbreak to settle a cloud bison; show only the folded carried state. No second person or extra inventory. Action design rationale, not an additional depicted scene: The folded screen blocks a snapping sail; opened and braced on the ground it creates a calm pocket that redirects a frightened bison. No flight or extra carried tools.
entries.caption: 34; Windmill climber and storm rescue challenger. Impatient, fearless at height and nervous in crowds. Wants to install a public storm shelter on a hill reserved for wealthy growers.

entries.title: Ruth Sable — Independent dye broker and reed-fencing rival
entries.brief: One new adult woman, Ruth Sable, age 47. Tall, lean and broad-shouldered with a long straight torso and strong hands; architectural rectangular silhouette. Face: Very dark skin, shaved head, broad nose bridge, high wide cheekbones, deep-set amber-brown eyes and a small firm mouth; no split black-white hair. Costume: Bone sleeveless straight high-neck coat over a black column dress slit only to the calf, flat silver-gray shoes and one narrow crimson interior facing; no jewelry or glove. Pose and expression: Elegant long forward fencing step, bone straight coat creating one severe pale slash against black; single closed reed shear held forward from its joined loop grip, free hand poised behind. Cool challenging half-smile, strong mature face, entire body and shear visible. Exactly one held object: Reed shear; One long closed silver pruning shear, two blunt beak blades and two plain black loop handles joined at a single pivot. It cuts a mature reed at one clean joint without shredding its living root. No second person or extra inventory. entries.caption: 47; Independent dye broker and reed-fencing rival. Controlled, persuasive and angry when courtesy is used to conceal cruelty. Wants to break the guild's forced-harvest contracts without abandoning workers who need wages now.

entries.brief: One complete creature. Scale: Shoulder-high adult, four-foot stance about two meters wide. Body: One closed black teardrop bud held upright above a short knotted pale root hub; one smooth bone-white vertical face slit with two tiny dark eyes, crimson visible only between the bud's two main overlapping halves. Fixed topology: {"legs": 4, "arms": 0, "wings": 0, "tails": 0, "other": "Exactly four thick bent root legs ending in broad blunt tips; no fine root fringe, antlers or secondary tendrils. The two bud halves are body plates, not wings."}. Pose: Complete closed-bud three-quarter stance with all four root legs separately visible; one leg lifted slightly, no action effects or open-mouth explosion. Behavior informs the design: Remains rooted during winter; forced heat wakes it to walk toward the warmest occupied room and wrap its four legs around the heat source.
entries.caption: Shoulder-high adult, four-foot stance about two meters wide. Remains rooted during winter; forced heat wakes it to walk toward the warmest occupied room and wrap its four legs around the heat source.

topology.other: Exactly four thick bent root legs ending in broad blunt tips; no fine root fringe, antlers or secondary tendrils. The two bud halves are body plates, not wings.

entries.title: The Last Dye House — three working tools
entries.brief: Exactly three separated objects on quiet ground; no characters, extra accessories, lettering or diagram insets. 1. Reed shear: One long closed silver pruning shear, two blunt beak blades and two plain black loop handles joined at a single pivot. Function: Cuts a mature reed at one clean joint without shredding its living root. 2. Dormancy jar: One broad bone ceramic sealed jar with a low black lid, one integral arch handle and a crimson wax seam. Function: Keeps one root cutting cool and dormant during transport; no visible specimen or extra inner jars. 3. Heat shutter: One handheld rectangular black ceramic plate with a dull-silver rim and one insulated rear grip visible at its edge. Function: Blocks radiant heat while a gardener closes a forced-growth furnace; a practical barrier, not an ornate weapon shield.
entries.caption: Three functional tools; the two character candidates each hold one matching item. Scale may differ between objects for legibility.
